concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-vault-update]] - Control Panel Vault customer, payment-method and address updates, with the high-volume API route and collected PCI, subscription, AVS and transaction-shipping boundaries
warnings: Keep this Control Panel workflow distinct from existing customer, payment-method and address API or SDK update sources.
Preserve that adding a Vault payment method does not automatically update existing subscriptions.
Do not turn the qualified PCI-scope warning or Verify card recommendation into a compliance or verification-success guarantee.
Preserve that the documented billing-address actions do not trigger AVS and that a specific transaction's shipping address cannot be changed after creation.
Do not infer current availability or unchanged limits from the 2026-09-16 collected snapshot.
